_comment: Keyed by cal_ref from channels.yaml. PT slope/intercept are psi/V and psi; LC are lbf/V and lbf. PT values below are the Omega PX309-2KG5V nominal transfer function (0-2000 psig over 0-5 V), NOT a bench calibration. LC slope is nominal, NOT a bench calibration: PUSHTON S1 2000 kg (4409.25 lbf) through a weight transmitter set to 0-10 V full scale. dpt0/dpt1 are differential PTs at 5.80151 psi/V.
